function.name: impl_from_IConnectionPoint
function.description: This function returns the containing record of the given interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the IConnectionPoint interface.

function.return_type: ConnectionPointImpl pointer, representing the containing record of the given interface.

function.name: impl_from_IEnumConnections
function.description: This function returns a pointer to the EnumConnectionsImpl structure that contains the IEnumConnections interface passed to it.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumConnections interface.

function.return_type: Pointer to EnumConnectionsImpl structure that contains the IEnumConnections interface.

function.name: ConnectionPointImpl_Destroy
function.description: This function releases the memory allocated for the sinks in the given ConnectionPointImpl object and then releases the memory allocated for the object itself.

parameters.name: Obj
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the ConnectionPointImpl object that needs to be destroyed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: ConnectionPointImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function performs a query on the interface of a connection point. It checks if the requested interface is supported, and if so, it increases the reference count of the interface and returns it.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the connection point.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the interface pointer will be stored, if the interface is supported.

function.return_type: HRESULT, where a successful operation returns S_OK, E_INVALIDARG if ppvObject is NULL, and E_NOINTERFACE if the requested interface is not supported.

function.name: ConnectionPointImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of a ConnectionPointImpl object and returns the updated count.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IConnectionPoint interface object.

function.return_type: ULONG, representing the updated reference count of the ConnectionPointImpl object.

function.name: ConnectionPointImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases a connection point interface, decrements the reference count, and destroys the connection point if the reference count is zero.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the IConnectionPoint interface that is to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count after the release operation.

function.name: ConnectionPointImpl_GetConnectionInterface
function.description: This function retrieves the interface identifier (IID) of the outgoing interface managed by the connection point.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IConnectionPoint interface

parameters.name: piid
parameters.description: Address of caller-allocated interface identifier (IID) that receives the IID of the outgoing interface managed by the connection point

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call to the function. S_OK if successful

function.name: ConnectionPointImpl_GetConnectionPointContainer
function.description: This function retrieves the connection point container associated with a specific connection point.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a connection point.

parameters.name: ppCPC
parameters.description: Address of a pointer to a IConnectionPointContainer interface. On successful return, this address contains the requested interface pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call to the function. It can indicate success, warning or error values.

function.name: ConnectionPointImpl_Advise
function.description: This function is used to establish a connection point between a component and its client. It also manages the list of sinks (clients that have requested notifications) and assigns a unique cookie to each connection.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IConnectionPoint interface.

parameters.name: lpUnk
parameters.description: Pointer to the IUnknown interface of the advise sink.

parameters.name: pdwCookie
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the connection cookie.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error value otherwise.

function.name: ConnectionPointImpl_Unadvise
function.description: This function unadvises or disconnects a connection point from a specific sink, identified by the dwCookie parameter. If the dwCookie is invalid or there is no connection, the function returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the connection point object.

parameters.name: dwCookie
parameters.description: This is an identifier for the sink to be disconnected.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the dwCookie is invalid, and CONNECT_E_NOCONNECTION if there is no connection.

function.name: ConnectionPointImpl_EnumConnections
function.description: This function enumerates the connections in a connection point object. It creates an enumeration object, queries its interface, and releases it. The function also handles memory allocation and deallocation for the connection data.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IConnectionPoint interface of the connection point object

parameters.name: ppEnum
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IEnumConnections interface, which will be set to the address of the enumeration object

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns OLE_E_NOCONNECTION if there are no connections, and the result of IEnumConnections_QueryInterface otherwise

function.name: EnumConnectionsImpl_Construct
function.description: This function constructs an instance of EnumConnectionsImpl, initializes its properties, and returns a pointer to it.

parameters.name: pUnk
parameters.description: Pointer to an IUnknown interface that the EnumConnectionsImpl object will reference.

parameters.name: nSinks
parameters.description: The number of connections to be enumerated.

parameters.name: pCD
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of CONNECTDATA structures representing the connections.

function.return_type: EnumConnectionsImpl *; Pointer to the constructed EnumConnectionsImpl object.

function.name: EnumConnectionsImpl_Destroy
function.description: This function releases the connections and frees the memory allocated for the connections and the object itself.

parameters.name: Obj
parameters.description: Pointer to the object that contains the connections to be released and freed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return any value.

function.name: EnumConnectionsImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface supports the requested interface ID (IID). If it does, it returns a pointer to this interface; otherwise, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that is being queried.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: If the interface is supported, upon return, this will point to the requested interface.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE if the interface is not supported, and E_INVALIDARG if ppvObject is NULL.

function.name: EnumConnectionsImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of an EnumConnectionsImpl object and returns the updated count.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IEnumConnections interface object

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count of the EnumConnectionsImpl object

function.name: EnumConnectionsImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases an interface of IEnumConnections type, decrements the reference count, and destroys the interface if the reference count is zero.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the current reference count after decrement.

function.name: EnumConnectionsImpl_Next
function.description: This function iterates over a list of connections, incrementing the current connection index and adding a reference to the connection's unknown interface. It also checks for null pointers and invalid connection counts.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface for enumerating connections

parameters.name: cConn
parameters.description: Number of connections to iterate over

parameters.name: pCD
parameters.description: Pointer to a connection data structure

parameters.name: pEnum
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable to store the number of connections processed

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK on success, E_POINTER if pEnum is NULL and cConn is not 1, and S_FALSE if the current connection index is greater than or equal to the total number of connections

function.name: EnumConnectionsImpl_Skip
function.description: This function skips a specified number of connections in the enumeration sequence.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for the enumeration of connections.

parameters.name: cSkip
parameters.description: The number of connections to skip in the enumeration sequence.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, and S_FALSE if the end of the sequence is reached.

function.name: EnumConnectionsImpl_Reset
function.description: This function resets the current position of the enumeration sequence to the beginning.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is an interface pointer used to access the enumeration sequence.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK indicates success.

function.name: EnumConnectionsImpl_Clone
function.description: This function clones an instance of the EnumConnectionsImpl object and increments the reference count of the original object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the original EnumConnectionsImpl object to be cloned.

parameters.name: ppEnum
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer of the new cloned EnumConnectionsImpl object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK if the operation was successful.

function.name: CreateConnectionPoint
function.description: This function creates a connection point, allocates memory for it, initializes its properties and returns a pointer to it.

parameters.name: pUnk
parameters.description: Pointer to an IUnknown interface that the connection point will be associated with.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface that the connection point will be associated with.

parameters.name: pCP
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IConnectionPoint interface. This will be set to point to the created connection point.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error code if the operation fails.
